legend: Byteburg Senate elections are coming. Usually "United Byteland", the ruling Byteland party, takes all the seats in the Senate to ensure stability and sustainable development. But this year there is one opposition candidate in one of the constituencies. Even one opposition member can disturb the stability in the Senate, so the head of the Party asks you to ensure that the opposition candidate will not be elected.

There are n$$$n$$$ candidates, numbered from 1 to n$$$n$$$. Candidate n$$$n$$$ is the opposition candidate. There are m$$$m$$$ polling stations in the constituency, numbered from 1 to m$$$m$$$. You know the number of votes cast for each candidate at each polling station. The only thing you can do to prevent the election of the opposition candidate is to cancel the election results at some polling stations. The opposition candidate will be elected if the sum of the votes cast in their favor at all non-canceled stations will be strictly greater than the analogous sum for every other candidate.

Your task is to prevent the election of the opposition candidate by canceling the election results at the minimal possible number of polling stations. Notice that solution always exists, because if you cancel the elections at all polling stations, the number of votes for each candidate will be 0, and the opposition candidate will not be elected.
input: The first line of the input contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and m$$$m$$$ (2≤n≤100$$$2\le n\le 100$$$; 1≤m≤100$$$1\le m \le 100$$$) — the number of candidates and the number of polling stations. The next m$$$m$$$ lines contain the election results at each polling station with n$$$n$$$ numbers on each line. In the i$$$i$$$-th line the j$$$j$$$-th number is ai,j$$$a_{i,j}$$$ — the number of votes cast for the candidate j$$$j$$$ at the station i$$$i$$$ (0≤ai,j≤1000$$$0\le a_{i,j} \le 1\,000$$$).
output: In the first line output integer k$$$k$$$ — the minimal number of the polling stations in which you need to cancel the election results. In the second line output k$$$k$$$ integers — the indices of canceled polling stations, in any order. If there are multiple ways to cancel results at k$$$k$$$ stations, output any one of them.
note: In the first example, the candidates from 1 to 5 received 14, 12, 13, 15, and 24 votes correspondingly. The opposition candidate has the most votes. However, if you cancel the election results at the first and the third polling stations, then only the result from the second polling station remains and the vote sums become 3, 7, 5, 6, and 7, without the opposition candidate being in the lead anymore.

legend.ai: Byteburg 参议院选举即将举行。通常，执政党“United Byteland”会赢得参议院的全部席位，以确保稳定与可持续发展。但今年，其中一个选区有一名反对派候选人。即使只有一名反对派成员当选，也可能破坏参议院的稳定，因此党首要求你确保这名反对派候选人不会当选。

共有 n$$$n$$$ 名候选人，编号从 1 到 n$$$n$$$。候选人 n$$$n$$$ 是反对派候选人。该选区有 m$$$m$$$ 个投票站，编号从 1 到 m$$$m$$$。你知道每个投票站为每位候选人投出的票数。为了阻止反对派候选人当选，你唯一能做的事情是在一些投票站取消选举结果。当且仅当在所有未被取消的投票站中，反对派候选人获得的票数总和严格大于其他每位候选人的对应票数总和时，反对派候选人才会当选。
你的任务是取消尽可能少的投票站的选举结果，以阻止反对派候选人当选。注意，解总是存在的，因为如果取消所有投票站的选举结果，那么每位候选人的票数都会变为 0，反对派候选人也就不会当选。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含两个整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 m$$$m$$$(2≤n≤100$$$2\le n\le 100$$$；1≤m≤100$$$1\le m \le 100$$$)，分别表示候选人的数量和投票站的数量。接下来的 m$$$m$$$ 行包含每个投票站的选举结果，每行有 n$$$n$$$ 个数字。在第 i$$$i$$$ 行中，第 j$$$j$$$ 个数字为 ai,j$$$a_{i,j}$$$，表示在第 i$$$i$$$ 个投票站为候选人 j$$$j$$$ 投出的票数(0≤ai,j≤1000$$$0\le a_{i,j} \le 1\,000$$$)。

output.ai: 第一行输出整数 k$$$k$$$，表示需要取消选举结果的投票站的最小数量。第二行输出 k$$$k$$$ 个整数，表示被取消选举结果的投票站的编号，顺序任意。如果有多种方案可以取消 k$$$k$$$ 个投票站的结果，输出其中任意一种即可。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，1 至 5 号候选人分别获得了 14、12、13、15 和 24 票。反对派候选人的票数最多。然而，如果取消第一个和第三个投票站的选举结果，那么只剩下第二个投票站的结果，票数总和将变为 3、7、5、6 和 7，此时反对派候选人不再领先。
